description:
Keep nighttime necessities close at hand with the French Country 3 Drawer Nightstand. It gives you three drawers for pacifiers, lotions, burp cloths, and books, and a top for a lamp or baby monitor.

The dovetailed drawers have full-extension glides. The nightstand measures 24 inches wide, 28 inches high, and 19 inches deep, and it is crafted from solid wood with the signature French Country detailing.
title: French Country 3 Drawer Nightstand
